rows.grounds: by divine weapons; instrumental plural masculine
of the supreme world; genitive singular masculine

items.question: Does death by divine weapons secure purification and attainment of the supreme world?
items.inference: Death by divine weapons yields purification and supreme-world attainment.
uncertainties: Exact syntactic relation of pāvanaṃ to prāptiḥ remains unresolved.
items.plain_english: Purification by divine weapons, and attainment of the supreme world.
